description: Create a purchasable product for a Neblla app. type must be "one_time" (single purchase, fixed price), "consumable" (quantity selector, price per unit) or "subscription" (renews every month or year by itself: price per period, interval, optional trialDays; the user manages it with neblla.shop.manage). name should be a multi-language object e.g. { en: "Gold Coins", es: "Monedas de Oro" }. price (one_time, subscription) and pricePerUnit (consumable) are in cents (e.g. 499 = $4.99). A product is an entitlement inside the app — a permission or a counter — or, with `shipping`, a PHYSICAL product (one_time or consumable): prints of a photo, mugs, T-shirts, a printed fanzine. shipping: { zones: [{ name, countries: ["ES"], amount }] } (postage in cents, 0 free; a country in one zone): the checkout asks for the address in the zone of the buyer's country (neblla.shop.buy(id, n, { country: "ES" }); with one zone it needs none; several and no country answers country_required with the zones, for the app to ask) and charges its postage; each payment becomes an ORDER (neblla_orders: paid → shipped with carrier and tracking → delivered, or returned), the buyer hears each step in their inbox, and the EU's 14 days to withdraw show on each delivered order. Labels, warehouses and carts of many articles are Shopify's: say so when a shop needs them. Payouts go to the developer, so one seller to many buyers works and a multi-seller marketplace does not. WHAT IS SOLD IS OFTEN NOT A FILE: `content` gives a one_time product or a subscription private links or texts (a Canva template «Abrir en Canva», a hidden course video, a game code, a Discord invite), read only by who holds it with neblla.media.mine(); files are unlocked with neblla_media "link". UNITS FOR SALE (stock, one_time and consumable): an edition of 10 prints, 100 legendary swords, 50 mugs, concert tickets without a seat. The catalogue (neblla.shop.products) says how many are left ({ units, left, soldOut }); opening the payment holds the units while the checkout lives (about 30 minutes): paid, they are sold; abandoned, they come back; refunded, they go back on sale unless stockRefundReturns is false. Never sold twice; a buy past the last one is refused with sold_out.

content.description: PRIVATE CONTENT the buyer gets beside its files (one_time: for good; subscription: while it lives): a link (a Canva template, a hidden video, a Discord invite) or a short text (a code, instructions). Never in the public catalogue; the buyer reads it with neblla.media.mine() (`content`). Neblla controls who sees it, not whether the buyer passes it on

label.description: What the button says, e.g. "Abrir en Canva" or { es, en }

text.description: Up to 2000 characters: a code, access instructions

currency.description: ISO 4217 code Stripe charges in, e.g. "usd" (default eur). Prices are in its smallest unit: cents for most, whole units for zero-decimal ones (jpy, krw…), thousandths ending in 0 for bhd, jod, kwd, omr, tnd; a price under Stripe's minimum charge in that currency (0.50 EUR/USD…) is refused

name.description: Product name, string or { en: "...", es: "..." }

price.description: Price in cents — required for one_time, and per period for subscription

pricePerUnit.description: Price per unit in cents — required for consumable

published.description: Buyable right away (default true). Without an active payout account it waits, hidden, and publishes by itself once the account is active (connectUrl opens the onboarding).

shipping.description: Physical product (one_time or consumable): where it ships and the postage of each zone

amount.description: Postage in cents (the product's currency); 0 is free

name.description: What the buyer sees at the checkout, e.g. "España" or "Resto de Europa"

stock.description: Units for sale in all (one_time and consumable); omit for no limit

stockRefundReturns.description: Whether a refunded unit goes back on sale (default true; false for e.g. a numbered, signed edition)

name: neblla_create_product
